# FRAZIL representative listening corpus

This directory is reserved for future **LISTENING-001 / Layer D
Representative Listening Corpus** material. It is not part of `TESTDATA-001`
and is not a byte-exact engineering regression fixture.

`LISTENING-001` may be prepared before M1 is complete, but it is not an M1
Exit Gate. It must be ready before `EXP-W-003`, `EXP-I-003`, `WATER-006`, and
`ICE-006` perceptual selection or final listening evidence. Engineering
experiments `EXP-W-002` and `EXP-I-002` may use `TESTDATA-001` without waiting
for this corpus.

Future material may cover drums, vocal, piano, guitar, bass, pad, and full-mix
examples when it has a real musical listening purpose. It must not be added
only to make the canonical engineering corpus sound more realistic.

Every submitted recording must document:

- source and author;
- license and explicit redistribution permission;
- content hash;
- sample rate, bit depth, channels, and duration;
- repository/storage policy.

Material without clear redistribution permission must not be committed. The
listening review uses this corpus to assess Water Identity, Crystal Identity,
Input Recognizability, Motion/Fluidity, Friction/Fracture, Transient Quality,
Musical Usefulness, and Artifact Severity. No real audio is included by the
TESTDATA-001 engineering-signal work.

DAW compatibility, automation, save/reopen, and Host acceptance evidence
belong to `HOST-001`. This corpus may provide audio material used in a DAW
test, but it does not itself constitute DAW acceptance.
